title: A · Черничный
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Draw ONE finished portrait MOBILE GAME INTERFACE concept, 1024x1536, for Buzzle “Какао-сорт” Water Sort. It must look like a coherent minigame screen inside existing Buzzle, NOT standalone demo webpage. References: image1 actual Buzzle winter-blueberry gameplay UI owns rounded typography, compact HUD and soft panels; image2 actual Buzzle cream collection UI owns warm readable type and cream surfaces; image3 current bad prototype screenshot is ONLY negative reference: do NOT copy thick hexagon gold mug frames, debug menus, giant tool panels. All three proposed directions use identical 6 mugs and exact initial game state so design can be compared. Six large attractive EMPTY-CAVITY stylized glass mugs, TWO ROWS OF THREE, camera frontal slightly above. Each body tall rounded rectangular cylinder with lightly chamfered low-poly sides and small right handle. THIN warm amber glass edge only 3–5% body width, matte cream rim highlight, transparent front; no giant gold hexagonal outline, no chunky frame or chrome. Colored liquid layers clearly visible and evenly sized, four layers per full mug. Top row mugs bottom-to-top: cocoa brown / amber / brown / amber; amber / brown / amber / brown; green / cream / green / cream. Bottom row: cream / green / cream / green; completely empty; completely empty. No extra cups anywhere in scene. Pretty simplified softly faceted art materials like Buzzle bee; no realistic photography or glossy reflections. HUD needs small back/close icon, “Какао-сорт”, “Уровень 1”, “Ходы: 0”, 3 star indicators. Bottom ONLY two usable game actions with icons and counts: “Отменить · 3” and “+ кружка · 1”. One small help line “Выбери кружку, затем другую”. NO global tabs, no timer, score, currency bar, palette legend, cup indices or 4/4 labels, debug text, switches for skins/animation/levels. Those belong in settings, not gameplay. Cups dominate, generous tap gaps, no overlaps or clipped content. No UI outside screen, no device frame, no watermark. Render all text accurately in friendly rounded Buzzle font. State is static comparison concept, not animation. DIRECTION A PRIMARY: strongest match to existing Buzzle puzzle night UI in reference1. Rounded restrained BLUEBERRY panels #282f59 with cream typography #fff0d8, soft gold used only for tiny stars and small action badges. One compact top status panel: title and level above, move count and star progress below. Quiet soft winter cafe scene dimmed purple-blue behind gameplay, tiny warm window light at extreme upper edges. Two shallow slender warm wooden shelves below cups, not a board panel. Bottom action dock dark blueberry with two equal rounded buttons, no bright borders. Main play area open over background. One small first-mug selection warm cream halo, no thick glow. Clean coherent Buzzle screen, not toy shop poster.
